items.label: Critical
items.summary: A remote attacker can take the application, or the host under it, with little or no user interaction.

sections.title: How this band is used here

content.value: Critical means the finding crosses from the application into code execution or an equivalent full compromise, and the conditions are realistic on a default deployment. CVSS 9.0 to 10.0.
These reports go out with a concrete remediation, not only a description. The public write-up waits for the release that removes the primitive.

items.label: High
items.summary: A trusted boundary fails. An attacker who already has some access, or who can ride an existing session, can expand or keep that access.

sections.title: How this band is used here

content.value: High covers broken authorization and session failures that let a revoked person keep acting as an administrator, or that expose sensitive data to someone who should have lost that right. CVSS 7.0 to 8.9.

items.label: Medium
items.summary: The weakness is real, and the impact is bounded by privileges, user interaction, or a narrower confidentiality, integrity, or availability loss.

sections.title: How this band is used here

content.value: Medium is reserved for flaws that still deserve a CVE and a patch, without the direct path to full compromise that Critical and High describe. CVSS 4.0 to 6.9. No record in the current archive sits in this band.

items.label: Low
items.summary: A broken primitive or a defense that no longer matches current practice. Impact usually needs a second failure, such as a leaked database.

sections.title: How this band is used here

content.value: Low does not mean optional. A weak hash, a missing expiration, or a verbose error is still a defect in the security control. It is published with the same timeline discipline as a critical issue. CVSS 0.1 to 3.9, when a score was assigned.

items.label: None
items.summary: No direct security impact under CVSS. Kept so the scale stays complete when a record is informational.

sections.title: How this band is used here

content.value: None is the CVSS floor. A record would land here only when the issue is worth documenting and has no scored impact. The archive does not use it today.
